articles.summary: Cineverse (Nasdaq: CNVS), an entertainment technology company and studio, has announced the launch of eight video podcasts on Amazon Fire TV. This marks the company's first major distribution of ad-supported video-on-demand (AVOD) podcasts (VODcasts), furthering its commitment to growing the Cineverse Podcast Network – including horror shows from Bloody FM and comedy from the WITZ Podcast Network. Additionally, some of Cineverse's most popular free, ad-supported streaming television (FAST) channels are also available via Fire TV. Shows now available to all Amazon Fire TV customers – with no download, sign-ups, or fees – include: Bad Movies Rule! – A comedy podcast for people who love so-called bad movies - those that have been declared bad by critics or audiences to see if they really deserve to be on the trash pile or if they actually rule. Mohr Stories with Jay Mohr – hosted by comedian/actor and SNL alum Jay Mohr, featuring candid, often humorous interviews with celebrities,
articles.title: Cineverse Brings Video Podcasts Bad Movies Rule!, Mohr Stories with Jay Mohr, and The Stand Presents: 10 for 10 to Amazon Fire TV
